settings.heading: Sculpted by Hand, Hallmarked for Eternity
settings.description:
In our atelier, silver is not treated as a substitute for gold, but as a sovereign canvas of light. We hand-carve waxes, cast certified 925 bullion, and set each gemstone under microscopic scrutiny.

Finished with a protective bath of liquid rhodium, each piece maintains its mirror brilliance without tarnishing over time.

settings.subtitle: The Silversmith Heritage
settings.title: Honoring Pure Sterling Silver
settings.text:
Indiasilvo was founded on a singular passion: celebrating sterling silver as the ultimate medium of modern fine jewellery. We blend royal Indian silver-craft traditions with architectural minimalism.

Each creation is cast strictly in BIS hallmarked 925 sterling silver, electro-coated with liquid rhodium for lifetime tarnish resistance, and finished by fifth-generation master artisans.
